name: Creative / Statement

intent_defaults.description: An exploratory starting point for expressive shape, proportion, surface and construction; the wearer defines what makes the design successful.
intent_defaults.silhouette: Open exploration: asymmetric, layered, oversized, fitted or user-defined

component_defaults.proportion: Explore non-standard proportion while preserving user-selected protected features
component_defaults.construction: Allow multiple construction routes and expose feasibility trade-offs

accessibility_defaults: The user decides which expressive features are essential and which may be changed for construction.
circularity_defaults: When embellishments or mixed materials are used, document their attachment and separation method.
caveats: Novelty is not an objective truth; evaluate against the user's own brief and rights-cleared references.
Unusual or complex geometry may require specialist sampling and physical validation before production.
